description: Replace the per-product Excluded pages board — paths whose visits are discarded at intake (never stored, never counted). DESTRUCTIVE: it changes what the site's analytics records. MCP clients should prompt the site owner before calling; regardless, set confirm=true ONLY after the owner explicitly approved the exact list in the conversation. An empty array removes all exclusions. Requires a key with the submit scope

confirm.description: Must be true, and may only be true after the site owner approved this exact list in the conversation

paths.description: FULL replacement list of absolute paths (e.g. /admin also covers /admin/settings; max 25) — an empty array clears the board

name: set_excluded_pages
